_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Unvanquished
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Unvanquished, the free team-based shooter of humans against aliens who build bases. Installs a release with its maps, and runs home/config/server.cfg at every start.
startup: exec ./daemonded -homepath /home/container/home -set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} -set sv_hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" -set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -set g_password "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" -set rcon.server.password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +exec server.cfg +map {{MAP}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Unvanquished. Downloads a release from GitHub, checks it against the
# release's SHA-512 list, and keeps the Linux engine and the game's own
# packages (pkg/). Your settings and downloads (home/) and packages you add
# to home/pkg are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
*) fail "Unvanquished's server only runs on x86-64 (amd64) machines." ;;
esac

want=${VERSION:-latest}
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag Unvanquished/Unvanquished "$want") ||
    fail "Unvanquished ${VERSION} doesn't exist. Check Version and reinstall."
version=${tag#v}

if [ -x daemonded ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Unvanquished $version is already installed."
else
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/x"
    zip="unvanquished_$version.zip"
    echo "Downloading Unvanquished $version (about 600 MB)"
    gh-release download Unvanquished/Unvanquished "$tag" "$zip" "$build/u.zip" ||
        fail "The download from GitHub failed. Reinstall to try again."
    # The release also publishes SHA-512s; check against those too.
    sum=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://github.com/Unvanquished/Unvanquished/releases/download/$tag/unvanquished_$version.sha512sum" |
        awk -v f="$zip" '{ n = $2; sub(/^\*/, "", n) } n == f { print $1 }') || sum=
    if [ -n "$sum" ]; then
        [ "$(sha512sum "$build/u.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] ||
            fail "The download didn't match the release's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    unzip -q "$build/u.zip" "unvanquished_$version/linux-$arch.zip" "unvanquished_$version/pkg/*" -d "$build/x" ||
        fail "Unvanquished's download has no Linux server in it."
    rel="$build/x/unvanquished_$version"
    unzip -q -o "$rel/linux-$arch.zip" -d "$build/engine"
    # Swap in the new packages: the previous release's are removed, any
    # other file in pkg/ stays.
    mkdir -p pkg
    if [ -f .raptor-pkgs ]; then
        while IFS= read -r f; do [ -z "$f" ] || rm -f "pkg/$f"; done < .raptor-pkgs
    fi
    (cd "$rel/pkg" && ls -1 *.dpk) > "$build/pkgs"
    mv -f "$rel"/pkg/*.dpk pkg/
    mv -f "$build/pkgs" .raptor-pkgs
    chmod +x "$build"/engine/daemon* "$build"/engine/nacl_* "$build"/engine/crash_server
    # Only what the dedicated server needs; daemon and daemon-tty are the game client.
    for f in daemonded crash_server nacl_helper_bootstrap nacl_loader irt_core-$arch.nexe; do
        mv -f "$build/engine/$f" "$f"
    done
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

# A starting config, only when there is none: the Panel sets the port, name
# and slots at each start; the rest is yours to change.
mkdir -p home/config
[ -f home/config/server.cfg ] || cat > home/config/server.cfg <<'EOF'
// Unvanquished server settings, run at every start. The port, server name,
// player slots and password come from the server's variables.
set g_motd "Welcome to an Unvanquished server."
set sv_contact ""
EOF
echo "Installed Unvanquished $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Unvanquished release, such as 0.56.2, or latest for the newest one. Players need the same release. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as plat23, chasm or yocto; the map rotation takes over after it.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin commands over rcon. Empty turns rcon off.
